pages.title: About CapitaLand Group | CapitaLand
pages.metaDescription: CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio spans across diversified real estate classes which include integrated developments, retail, office, lodging, residential and new economy sectors such as business parks, industrial, logistics and data centres.
pages.mainText: About Us Within its ecosystem, CapitaLand has developed an integrated suite of investment, development and operating capabilities that support its businesses and platforms in building core competencies across the real estate value chain. With this full stack of capabilities, CapitaLand can optimise the strategies of its listed real asset management business CapitaLand Investment (CLI), and its privately held property development arm CapitaLand Development (CLD); to drive competitive advantage for its businesses. CapitaLand places sustainability at the core of what it does. As a responsible real estate company, CapitaLand contributes to the environmental and social well-being of the communities where it operates, as it delivers long-term economic value to its stakeholders. Our global presence CapitaLand owns and manages properties across a range of asset classes and geographies. Find out more Board of Directors Our Board provides strategic guidance and policy direction for our management. Find out more Our Core Values Our core values define how we do business and interact with our colleagues, partners and customers everywhere we operate. CLI may exercise the right to acquire the Relevant Assets (or, as the case may be, the interests in the Relevant Assets) for its own portfolio of pipeline assets, or CLI may exercise it in favour of any Relevant CLI Entity. “Relevant Assets” refers to any operational, income-producing properties for the following non-exhaustive uses: residential, retail, office, business park, industrial, logistics, data centre and mixed use properties, and lodging related (including multifamily, student accommodation, hotels and serviced apartments, amongst others) located anywhere in the world, and where the context so admits, shall include the shares and equity interests of any single purpose company or entity established to hold the Relevant Asset​. pages.metaDescription: Working at CapitaLand provides you the opportunity to work alongside a vastly talented international workforce, while you gain access to skills and development programmes aimed to promote continual learning.
pages.mainText: Careers with CapitaLand Group At CapitaLand, our talent strategy goes beyond just recruiting suitable candidates with the right skills and values. We strive to help our people grow at every stage of their careers, recognise their contributions and hard work, and reward them for their efforts and achievements. We embrace diversity, foster inclusivity, and have built a strong team of highly talented employees around the world. To bring out the best in you, we provide quality professional and personal development programmes, as well as rewarding opportunities for you to continuously learn, grow and thrive at CapitaLand. Join our team and discover how you can make a positive lasting impact. pages.title: About Us | CapitaLand Investment
pages.metaDescription: CapitaLand Investment Limited is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia presence.
pages.mainText: MEDIA About CapitaLand Investment CapitaLand Investment (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong foothold in Asia. Headquartered and listed in Singapore, CLI connects institutional capital to real asset opportunities through its globally integrated fund management platforms. Operating in over 40 countries, CLI is focused on growing recurring fee earnings, recycling capital efficiently and delivering sustainable long-term value for shareholders through disciplined capital management and responsible investing. "CapitaLand Investment remains steadfast in being a trusted partner as we strengthen our position as a leading global real asset manager. Driven by our entrepreneurial spirit, we continue to innovate and pursue asset-light growth to drive long-term sustainable value for our investors." Lee Chee Koon Group Chief Executive Officer, CLI Leading Asia, Shaping the World We have deep local expertise in our core markets of Southeast Asia, China and India. Our global network extends to our key markets of Australia, Japan, Korea, Europe and the USA. As we grow our business, we will continue to push boundaries and shape markets across the world. We are committed to making a positive impact in the communities where we operate. Our Businesses See how our integrated business model enables us to drive asset-light growth. Read More Our Value Proposition See what differentiates us as a leading global real asset manager. Read More ONE CapitaLand Ecosystem See how CapitaLand Investment and CapitaLand Development partner for growth. Read More Our Leadership CLI’s Board of Directors and Management team have deep expertise and experience and an unwavering commitment to drive sustained growth. Board of Directors Management Team Our Story CapitaLand Investment (CLI) was listed on the Singapore Exchange on 20 September 2021 after CapitaLand Group restructured to privatise its real estate development business, CapitaLand Development, and list its real asset management business, CLI. Today, CLI is a leading global real asset manager with a strong foothold in Asia. Since the listing of CLI in 2021, our funds under management (FUM) have increased 47% from S$87 billion to S$128 billion as at 30 June 2026. We target to achieve FUM of S$200 billion by 2028. searchResults.title: Our Businesses | CapitaLand Investment
searchResults.highlight:
#### CapitaLand Investment's (CLI) business model adopts an integrated investment approach that creates sustainable value for our shareholders. Our Fee-Income Related Business (FRB) comprises Listed Funds Management, Private Funds Management, Commercial Management and Lodging Management. Together, they provide a steadily growing, recurring fee-based revenue stream.
...
#### Our Real Estate Investment Business (REIB) generates a stable flow of rental income from our global portfolio of commercial and lodging assets and is also a source of assets for CLI's managed investment vehicles.
...
CapitaLand launched Singapore's first listed real estate investment trust (REIT) in 2002. Today, CLI is Asia Pacific's largest REIT manager by market capitalisation. See how we have grown in this journey.
...
CLI manages diversified private funds, leveraging our strong local expertise across multiple asset classes. This gives us an edge in unlocking value from off-market opportunities. See how we create value for our capital partners.
...
CLI manages around 250 retail and workspace properties across Southeast Asia, China and India. See how the unique value proposition of our retail and workspace ecosystem brings value to our partners and tenants.
...
A rapidly expanding part of CLI's fee-based income comes from our asset-light lodging management and franchise contracts. See what that means for CLI on a global scale.
...
#### CLI owns and manages a geographically- and sector-diversified global real estate portfolio with a strong presence in Asia. We have an established presence in markets such as Southeast Asia, China, India, Australia, Japan and Korea. We are also expanding our businesses in key gateway cities in markets including Europe and the USA. Together, they provide balance and diversity to CLI’s portfolio, strengthening our resilience.Our integrated suite of real estate capabilities, extensive footprint and decades of experience give us a sustainable competitive edge to move swiftly to originate fund products and source from our pipeline assets for fund vehicles. Our real estate portfolio is managed through our comprehensive and expanding funds platform, which gives CLI sustainable fee-based income. Through our stakes in our fund vehicles, we also participate in the growth of these assets.

searchResults.title: Our Value Proposition | CapitaLand Investment
searchResults.highlight:
As a leading global real asset manager, CapitaLand Investment (CLI) is shaping the future of real assets by investing in strategies aligned with global megatrends, while creating long-term value for our investors.
...
We are focused on driving asset-light growth through disciplined capital management, operational excellence, a culture of innovation and strong commitment to environmental, social and governance (ESG) principles.
...
- - Our asset-light and capital-efficient business model enables us to remain agile in scaling CLI’s business and accelerating the growth of our recurring fee income and funds under management (FUM).
...
- - Our strong balance sheet provides flexibility to invest for future growth, including pursuing strategic mergers and acquisitions that enhance our capabilities, as well as warehousing assets to support new listed and private fund launches aligned with disruption, demographics and digitalisation-themed investment strategies.
...
- - We leverage our on-balance sheet properties to generate steady income and divest them at opportune times to drive capital recycling and potentially seed these assets into our funds to grow fee income.
...
- - We co-invest in our funds alongside our capital partners, ensuring alignment of interests.
...
- - Our best-in-class commercial management expertise and our global lodging business, The Ascott Limited, enable us to enhance the performance of assets under our listed and private funds. commercial management
...
- - CLI’s on-the-ground teams allow us to source off-market deals and ensure strong execution, driving quality returns for our capital partners.
...
- - Through our extensive global network, we connect our capital partners with high-quality investment opportunities across geographies and asset classes.
...
- - We leverage artificial intelligence (AI) to drive innovation and transform our business, enable agile decision-making to optimise performance, enhance operational efficiency, and improve customer engagement.
